records.title: AI Italian Brainrot Generator - Feature Showcase
records.body:
### The Ultimate Italian Brainrot Creation Experience
Transform your wildest ideas into authentic Italian Brainrot content with this comprehensive AI-powered generator. This free web tool brings together cutting-edge AI technology and the beloved Italian Brainrot aesthetic to create unique multimedia experiences from simple text prompts.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a05cec83-2cac-4bf9-8233-0bf9d7cc97a0)

### Triple-Format Content Generation
Visual Masterpieces
The generator produces stunning 3D-rendered characters that capture the essence of Italian Brainrot style. Each creation features the signature characteristics - exaggerated features, vibrant colors, and that perfect blend of cute and surreal that defines the aesthetic. Whether you imagine a "pizza-loving astronaut cat" or a "dancing spaghetti monster," the AI brings your vision to life with professional-quality 3D renders.
Surreal Italian Narratives
Beyond visuals, the tool generates contextual Italian text that embodies the absurdist humor of Brainrot culture. Each text creation captures the characteristic wordplay, nonsensical charm, and cultural references that make Italian Brainrot content so engaging. The AI understands the nuances of the style, producing narratives that feel authentically part of the Brainrot universe.
Authentic Voice Narration
Complete your Brainrot experience with AI-generated Italian voice narration. The audio brings your generated text to life, adding an immersive layer that makes content perfect for social media sharing. The natural-sounding Italian voice captures the playful spirit of Brainrot culture, turning simple text into engaging audio content.

### User-Friendly Design
Instant Generation
Simply enter a prompt and watch as three forms of content generate simultaneously. The streamlined interface shows real-time progress for each component, with the entire process typically completing within 30-60 seconds.
Smart Error Handling
Built-in safeguards ensure a smooth experience. If any component encounters issues, the system continues generating other content types while clearly indicating what went wrong. The 90-second timeout protection prevents endless waiting, automatically recovering from network issues.
Download and Share
All generated content is yours to keep. Download high-resolution images, copy text for posts, and save audio files for your creative projects. The tool requires no registration, no payment, and imposes no limits on generation - create as much Italian Brainrot content as your imagination allows.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fc264072-8392-4175-821a-154779ac1d7b)

### Perfect for Content Creators
Whether you're a social media influencer, digital artist, or meme enthusiast, this generator opens new creative possibilities. Join the Italian Brainrot movement and create content that stands out in the crowded digital landscape. From TikTok videos to Instagram posts, your AI-generated Brainrot creations will capture attention and spark joy across platforms.

records.title: 【开源自荐】BiliFilter —— 基于本地LLM的 Bilibili 弹幕过滤器
records.body:
# BiliFilter —— 基于本地LLM的 Bilibili 弹幕过滤器
仓库：[https://github.com/ddddng/BiliFilter/](https://github.com/ddddng/BiliFilter/)

> 本项目依赖 Hugging Face 上的配套微调模型  
> [`dddng/gemma3_4b_BiliFilter_v2`](https://huggingface.co/dddng/gemma3_4b_BiliFilter_v2)

借助 **[LM Studio](https://lmstudio.ai/)** 的 OpenAI 兼容本地接口，你可以在本地过滤B站弹幕。浏览器中只需安装脚本。

---

## ✨ 特性

* **本地运行**：所有推理均在本地完成  
* **多种分类**：色情低俗、恶意刷屏、人身攻击、垃圾广告、引战、剧透、错误科普、正常、未分类  
* **即装即用**：无需修改网页源代码，脚本自动 Hook 弹幕  
* **可调策略**：保留 / 隐藏指定分类、调试模式、并发与队列长度等均可一键修改

---

## 🚀 快速开始

### 1. 安装 LM Studio 并下载模型

1. 前往 <https://lmstudio.ai> 下载安装包并安装  
2. 下载`dddng/gemma3_4b_BiliFilter_v2`

### 2. 启动本地 OpenAI 兼容服务器并启用 CORS

1. 前往 **开发者**
2. 点击左上 **Settings**，勾选 **启用 CORS**  
3. 确认「Status」为 **Running**，端口默认为 **1234**

### 3. 安装浏览器脚本

1. 安装 [Tampermonkey](https://www.tampermonkey.net/)  
2. 点击「新建脚本」，粘贴BiliFilter.js的内容
3. 保存并刷新页面

## ⚙️ 高级配置

| 变量 | 功能 | 默认值 |
|------|------|--------|
| `BATCH_SIZE` | 单次推送给模型的弹幕数 | `10` |
| `MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS` | 并发请求上限 | `2` |
| `KEEP_CATEGORIES` | 永远保留的分类集合 | `['正常', '未分类']` |
| `SHOW_CATEGORY` | `true` 时在弹幕后追加 `[分类]` | `false` |
| `DEBUG` | 控制台输出调试信息 | `false` |
| `HIDE_BEFORE_RESPONSE` | 设置是否在 API 返回之前隐藏弹幕 | `true` |
| `BATCH_TIMEOUT` | 批次超时设置（单位：毫秒） | `500` |
| `MAX_QUEUE_LENGTH` | 排队弹幕的最大数量 | `0`（不排队） |

## gemma3_4b_BiliFilter_v2 模型性能

---

### 每个有害分类的过滤率（召回率 · 精确匹配）

| 分类       | 过滤率           |
| ---------- | ---------------- |
| 色情低俗   | 0.00% (0/0)      |
| 恶意刷屏   | 42.11% (8/19)    |
| 人身攻击   | 20.83% (5/24)    |
| 垃圾广告   | 0.00% (0/0)      |
| 引战       | 50.00% (3/6)     |
| 剧透       | 0.00% (0/0)      |
| 错误科普   | 0.00% (0/0)      |

---

### 每个有害分类的误杀率（真实为“正常”时误判比例）

| 分类       | 误杀率               |
| ---------- | -------------------- |
| 色情低俗   | 0.00% (0/153)        |
| 恶意刷屏   | 0.00% (0/153)        |
| 人身攻击   | 1.31% (2/153)        |
| 垃圾广告   | 0.00% (0/153)        |
| 引战       | 4.58% (7/153)        |
| 剧透       | 0.00% (0/153)        |
| 错误科普   | 0.00% (0/153)        |

---

### 总体统计

| 指标                                               | 数值           |
| -------------------------------------------------- | -------------- |
| 总体过滤率（精确匹配到具体类别）                   | 32.65% (16/49) |
| 总体过滤率（含错误类别，即识别为任意有害类）       | 46.94% (23/49) |
| 总体误杀率（正常样本被判为任意有害类）             | 5.88% (9/153)  |

---

### 样本量

- **处理的总样本数**：202  
- **“正常”样本数**（Ground Truth）：153  
- **“有害”样本数**（Ground Truth, item-level）：49

records.body:
[afdian-linker](https://github.com/CaoMeiYouRen/afdian-linker)：afdian-linker 是一个基于 Nuxt 3 & TypeScript 的全栈项目。集成了爱发电 API，提供统一的订单管理、赞助支付和外部查询能力。

**功能简介**

- 支持多支付渠道扩展（如爱发电等）
- 统一订单生命周期管理
- 安全的 API 查询接口
- 丰富的后台管理功能（订单、用户、商品、Webhook 日志等）
- 邮箱验证、第三方登录（Auth0）、初始密码/邮箱安全提醒
- 支持多种推送渠道（Server 酱、钉钉、企业微信、邮件等）
